45400.meaning1: severing of life; cutting off of life

examples.text: ahesuṃ kho ye, bhikkhu, tayā pubbe samaṇabrāhmaṇā lokasmiṃ pathavīgarahakā pathavījigucchakā… te kāyassa bhedā pāṇ'upacchedā hīne kāye patiṭṭhitā ahesuṃ.

45401.commentary: (MNa) pāṇ'upetan'ti pāṇehi upetaṃ, yāva me jīvitaṃ pavattati, tāva upetaṃ.

examples.text: es'āhaṃ, bho ānanda, taṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañ'ca bhikkhusaṅghañ'ca. upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ ānando dhāretu ajja't'agge pāṇ'upetaṃ saraṇaṃ gatan'ti.
taṃ yathā? cakkhu ca sotañ'ca cakkhusotaṃ, mukhañ'ca nāsikā ca mukhanāsikaṃ, chavi ca maṃsañ'ca lohitañ'ca chavimaṃsalohitaṃ. evaṃ pāṇy'aṅga-atthe.
sītā, bhante, hem'antikā ratti, antar'aṭṭhako himapātasamayo, kharā gokaṇṭakahatā bhūmi, tanuko paṇṇasantharo, viraḷāni rukkhassa pattāni, sītāni kāsāyāni vatthāni, sīto ca verambho vāto vāyati.

45404.grammar: masc, in comps, from pāteti, caus

examples.text: kosambiyaṃ piṇḍāya caritvā pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantā yena bhagavā ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu, upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ nisīdiṃsu.
paṭisaṅkhā yoniso piṇḍapātaṃ paṭisevāmi n'eva davāya na madāya na maṇḍanāya na vibhūsanāya yāva'd'eva imassa kāyassa ṭhitiyā yāpanāya vihiṃs'ūparatiyā brahmacariy'ānuggahāya

45405.grammar: masc, in comps, from pāteti, caus

examples.text: gām'ūpacāro nāma parikkhittassa gāmassa indakhīle ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto, aparikkhittassa gāmassa ghar'ūpacāre ṭhitassa majjhimassa purisassa leḍḍupāto.

yo pana tiṭṭha tiṭṭhā'ti vadati, pātehī'ti na vadati, itaro ca taṃ oloketvā sace esa maṃ pāpuṇeyya, ghāteyyā'pi man'ti sālayo'va hutvā taṃ bhaṇḍaṃ gahanaṭṭhāne pakkhipitvā puna nivattitvā gahessāmī'ti pakkamati, pātanapaccayā pārājikaṃ n'atthi. āgantvā pana theyyacittena gaṇhato uddhāre pārājikaṃ.
rājā mahāsudassano evam'āha, pāṇo na hantabbo, adinnaṃ na ādātabbaṃ, kāmesu micchā na caritabbā, musā na bhaṇitabbā, majjaṃ na pātabbaṃ, yathābhuttañ'ca bhuñjathā'ti.

yathā, mahārāja, jalūkā yattha allīyati, tatth'eva daḷhaṃ allīyitvā ruhiraṃ pivati, evam'eva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yog'āvacarena yasmiṃ ārammaṇe cittaṃ allīyati, taṃ ārammaṇaṃ vaṇṇato ca saṇṭhānato ca disato ca okāsato ca paricchedato ca liṅgato ca nimittato ca daḷhaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā ten'ev'ārammaṇena vimuttirasamasecanakaṃ pātabbaṃ.

45408.meaning1: comes to ruin; meets one's downfall

examples.text: sukho imissā paribbājikāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso'ti te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjanti.

45409.construction:
pāte + vya > bya + tā
pātabya + tā
45409.commentary: (VINa) pātabyassa bhāvo pātabyatā, chedanabhedan'ādīhi yathāruci paribhuñjitabbatā'ti attho.

examples.text: bhūtagāmapātabyatāya pācittiyaṃ.
sukho imissā paribbājikāya taruṇāya mudukāya lomasāya bāhāya samphasso'ti te kāmesu pātabyataṃ āpajjanti.

45410.meaning1: instructed in the morning; advised early in the day

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, bodhi rājakumāro bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, aho buddho, aho dhammo, aho dhammassa svākkhātatā! yatra hi nāma sāyam'anusiṭṭho pāto visesaṃ adhigamissati, pātam'anusiṭṭho sāyaṃ visesaṃ adhigamissatī'ti!
sakuṇo yathā paṃsukunthito, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajaṃ, evaṃ bhikkhu padhānavā satimā, vidhunaṃ pātayati sitaṃ rajan'ti.

45413.commentary: (SNPa) ettha ca pāto asitabbo'ti pātarāso, piṇḍapātass'etaṃ nāmaṃ.

examples.text: evañ'ca vadehi, ajja kira, bhante, rājā pasenadi kosalo pacchābhattaṃ bhuttapātarāso bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī'ti.
rūpā ca saddā ca rasā ca gandhā, phassā ca ye sammadayanti satte, etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, kālena so pavise pātarāsaṃ.

45414.commentary: (SNPa) ettha ca pāto asitabbo'ti pātarāso, piṇḍapātass'etaṃ nāmaṃ. yo yattha labbhati, so padeso'pi taṃ yogena pātarāso'ti idha vutto. yato piṇḍapātaṃ labhati, taṃ okāsaṃ gaccheyyā'ti evam'ettha attho veditabbo.

examples.text: rūpā ca saddā ca rasā ca gandhā, phassā ca ye sammadayanti satte, etesu dhammesu vineyya chandaṃ, kālena so pavise pātarāsaṃ.
evañ'ca vadehi, ajja kira, bhante, rājā pasenadi kosalo pacchābhattaṃ bhuttapātarāso bhagavantaṃ dassanāya upasaṅkamissatī'ti.

45416.meaning2: ate breakfast; lit. made morning meal

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, ānanda, rājā mahāsudassano tam'eva hatthiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno pubb'aṇhasamayaṃ abhiruhitvā samuddapariyantaṃ pathaviṃ anuyāyitvā kusāvatiṃ rājadhāniṃ paccāgantvā pātarāsam'akāsi.

45417.commentary: (MNa) sāyam'anusiṭṭho pāto visesaṃ adhigamissatī'ti atthaṅ'gate sūriye anusiṭṭho aruṇ'uggamane visesaṃ adhigamissati. pātam'anusiṭṭho sāyan'ti aruṇ'uggamane anusiṭṭho sūriy'atthaṅ'gamanavelāyaṃ. (THIa) sāyaṃ pātan'ti sāy'anhe pubb'aṇhe ca.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhikkhu, rañño sato khattiyassa muddh'āvasittassa caturāsītithālipākasahassāni ahesuṃ, sāyaṃ pātaṃ bhatt'ābhihāro abhihariyittha.
sassuyā sassurassa ca, sāyaṃ pātaṃ paṇāmam'upagamma, sirasā karomi pāde, vandāmi yathā'mhi anusiṭṭhā.

45418.commentary: (VINa) pātāpetī'ti athā'pi coro bhaṇḍahārakassa hatthe āvudhaṃ disvā sāsaṅko hutvā pātāpetvā gahetu'kāmo ekam'antaṃ paṭikkamma santajjetvā pātāpeti, parassa hatthato muttamatte pārājikaṃ.

45419.meaning2: abyss, proclivity, other side of the earth

examples.text: kadā nu gaṅgaṃ yamunaṃ sarassatiṃ, pātālakhittaṃ vaḷavāmukhañ'ca, asajjamāno patareyyam'iddhiyā, vibhiṃsanaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.
ekamūlaṃ dvi'r'āvaṭṭaṃ, timalaṃ pañcapattharaṃ, samuddaṃ dvādas'āvaṭṭaṃ, pātālaṃ atarī isī'ti.

45420.meaning1: mythological chasm inside the earth containing an ocean
45420.commentary: (THa) pātālakhittaṃ baḷavāmukhañ'cā'ti pātāya alaṃ pariyattan'ti pātālaṃ, tadeva khittaṃ, pathaviyā saṇṭhahanakāle tathā ṭhitanti pātālakhittaṃ.

examples.text: kadā nu gaṅgaṃ yamunaṃ sarassatiṃ, pātālakhittaṃ vaḷavāmukhañ'ca, asajjamāno patareyyam'iddhiyā, vibhiṃsanaṃ taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

45421.meaning1: chasm that is defilement; abyss of impurity
45421.notes: Mano-group nouns, while neuter in Sanskrit, are considered to be masculine by classical Pāḷi grammars such as Saddanīti. The example given is mano anicco, mano dukkho'ti. Counter-examples are amoghaṃ tapo and paramaṃ tapo.

examples.text: aratiṃ pajahāsi sato, bhavāsi sataṃ taṃ sārayāmase, pātālarajo hi duttaro, mā taṃ kāmarajo avāhari.

idha, bhikkhave, tadev'ekaccesu janapadesu, pātī'ti sañjānanti, pattan'ti sañjānanti, vittan'ti sañjānanti, sarāvan'ti sañjānanti, dhāropan'ti sañjānanti, poṇan'ti sañjānanti, pisīlavan'ti sañjānanti.
yassa rāgo ca doso ca, māno makkho ca pātito, sāsapo'r'iva ār'aggā, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.

45427.commentary: (VIN) pātimokkhan'ti ādim'etaṃ mukham'etaṃ pamukham'etaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ. tena vuccati pātimokkhan'ti. (KV) pātimokkhan'ti pa-atimokkhaṃ atipamokkhaṃ atiseṭṭhaṃ atiuttaman'ti attho.
45427.notes: There are numerous contested derivations of this word, both traditional and academic. Some of the more common ones are: - mukha, as in the entrance to all things wholesome. - pa mokkha, as in the foremost. - ati pa √muc, as in liberating. - pati √mokkh, as in the binding of a wound or the application of a medicine. - pāṭi 'sing', mukam 'face' from Tamil is a proposed non-Indo-Aryan origin.

examples.text: āpattiṃ na jānāti, anāpattiṃ na jānāti, lahukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, garukaṃ āpattiṃ na jānāti, ubhayāni kho pan'assa pātimokkhāni vitthārena na svāgatāni honti na suvibhattāni na suppavattīni na suvinicchitāni suttaso anubyañjanaso, imehi kho, bhikkhave, pañcah'aṅgehi samannāgatena bhikkhunā na upasampādetabbaṃ, na nissayo dātabbo, na sāmaṇero upaṭṭhāpetabbo.

45428.meaning2: collection of precepts contained in the Vinaya
45428.commentary: (VIN) pātimokkhan'ti ādim'etaṃ mukham'etaṃ pamukham'etaṃ kusalānaṃ dhammānaṃ. tena vuccati pātimokkhan'ti. (KV) pātimokkhan'ti paatimokkhaṃ atipamokkhaṃ atiseṭṭhaṃ atiuttaman'ti attho.
45428.notes: There are numerous contested derivations of this word, both traditional and academic. Some of the more common ones are: - mukha, as in the entrance to all things wholesome. - pa mokkha, as in the foremost. - ati pa √muc, as in liberating. - pati √mokkh, as in the binding of a wound or the application of a medicine. - pāṭi 'sing', mukam 'face' from Tamil is a proposed non-Indo-Aryan origin.

examples.text: ehi tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlavā hohi pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi
akittayī vivaṭacakkhu, sakkhidhammaṃ parissayavinayaṃ, paṭipadaṃ vadehi bhaddante, pātimokkhaṃ athavā'pi samādhiṃ.
paṇḍako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, paṇḍakakathā vippakatā hoti, bhikkhunidūsako tassaṃ parisāyaṃ nisinno hoti, bhikkhunidūsakakathā vippakatā hoti, ime kho, upāli, dasa pātimokkhaṭṭhapanā'ti.

45431.meaning1: included in the Patimokkkha; contained in the monastic precepts

examples.text: uddesapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesū'ti pātimokkhapariyāpannesu sikkhāpadesu.

45432.meaning1: restraint according to the Pātimokkha precepts

examples.text: kathaṃ paṭipanno pana, mārisa, bhikkhu pātimokkhasaṃvarāya paṭipanno hotī'ti? kāyasamācāraṃ'p'āhaṃ, devānam'inda, duvidhena vadāmi, sevitabbam'pi, asevitabbam'pi.

45433.meaning1: controlled by restraint of Patimokkha; restrained and controlled by the Pātimokkha precepts
45433.commentary: (SNa) pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto'ti catunnaṃ sīlānaṃ jeṭṭhakasīlaṃ dassento evam'āha… tasmā pātimokkhasaṃvaro'va sīlaṃ, tena pātimokkhasaṃvarena saṃvuto'ti pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto, upeto samannāgato'ti attho.

examples.text: sampannasīlā, bhikkhave, viharatha sampannapātimokkhā, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino, samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.
idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu sīlavā hoti, pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharati ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī, samādāya sikkhati sikkhāpadesu.

45434.meaning1: ethical conduct restrained by the Pātimokkha precepts

45435.meaningLit: discourse on restraint according to the Pātimokkha precepts

45436.meaning1: synonym for the recitation of precepts
45436.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi, na dān'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, ito paraṃ uposathaṃ karissāmi, pātimokkhaṃ uddisissāmi
suṇātu me bhante saṅgho? ajj'uposatho pannaraso, yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ, saṅgho uposathaṃ kareyya, pātimokkhaṃ uddiseyya.

45438.meaning1: recitation of the Pātimokkha; chanting of the monastic precepts

examples.text: santi kho pana me, udāyi, sāvakā āraññikā pantasen'āsanā araññavanapatthāni pantāni sen'āsanāni ajjhogāhetvā viharanti, te anvaddhamāsaṃ saṅghamajjhe osaranti pātimokkh'uddesāya.

45439.grammar: adj, in comps, from pāteti, caus
45439.commentary: (JAa) dūrepātī'ti yāva cātumahārājikabhavanā tāvatiṃsabhavanā ca kaṇḍaṃ pesetuṃ samatthatāya dūrepātī. (JAa) dūrepātī'ti saraṃ dūre pātetuṃ samatthā.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, issāso vā issās'antevāsī vā tiṇapurisarūpake vā mattikāpuñje vā yoggaṃ karitvā, so aparena samayena dūrepātī ca hoti akkhaṇavedhī ca mahato ca kāyassa padāletā.
dhanuggaho asadiso, rājaputto mahabbalo, dūrepātī akkhaṇavedhī, mahākāyappadālano.

45440.commentary: (MNa) avakkārapātin'ti atirekapiṇḍapātaṃ apanetvā ṭhapan'atthāya ekaṃ samuggapātiṃ dhovitvā ṭhapeti.

examples.text: idha, bhante, amhākaṃ yo paṭhamaṃ gāmato piṇḍāya paṭikkamati so āsanāni paññapeti, pānīyaṃ paribhojanīyaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, avakkārapātiṃ upaṭṭhāpeti
yathā kho, mārisā, nimittāni dissanti, uḷāro āloko sañjāyati, obhāso pātubhavati, brahmā pātubhavissati

idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso yo hoti parassa avaṇṇo taṃ apuṭṭho'pi pātu karoti, ko pana vādo puṭṭhassa! puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

idha, bhikkhave, asappuriso yo hoti parassa avaṇṇo taṃ apuṭṭho'pi pātu karoti, ko pana vādo puṭṭhassa! puṭṭho kho pana pañh'ābhinīto ahāpetvā alambitvā paripūraṃ vitthārena parassa avaṇṇaṃ bhāsitā hoti.

45445.commentary: (VINa) yasmā pana khīṇ'āsavā nāma na akāraṇā sitaṃ pātukaronti, tasmā taṃ lakkhaṇatthero pucchi, ko nu kho āvuso moggallāna hetu, ko paccayo sitassa pātukammāyā'ti.

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā maggā okkamma aññatarasmiṃ padese sitaṃ pātv'ākāsi. atha kho āyasmato ānandassa etadahosi, ko nu kho hetu, ko paccayo bhagavato sitassa pātukammāya?

surā-meraya-majja-pamāda-ṭṭhānassa pana sur'ādīnañ'ca aññataraṃ hoti madanīyapātu'kamyatācittañ'ca paccupaṭṭhitaṃ hoti, tajjañ'ca vāyāmaṃ āpajjati, pīte ca pavisatī'ti imāni cattāri aṅgānī'ti. evam'ettha aṅgato'pi viññātabbo vinicchayo.

45449.meaning1: having produced; having manifested; having given rise to

examples.text: tesu rājagahe piṇḍāya caritvā bhagavato santikaṃ gantvā nisinnesu lakkhaṇatthero pucchi, āvuso, moggallānaṃ tvaṃ gijjhakūṭā otaranto sitaṃ pātukaritvā mayā sitakāraṇaṃ puṭṭho bhagavato santike maṃ puccheyyāsī'ti avaca, kathehi idāni taṃ kāraṇan'ti.

45450.synonym: āharati, upadaṃseti, dassayati, paccanubhavati, paccupaṭṭhāpeti, padasseti, pamuñcati
45450.commentary: (MNa) pātukarissatī'ti pakāsessati dassessati. na hi sakkā tena tāni ettakena antarena dassetuṃ.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo kodhano hoti upāyāsabahulo, appam'pi vutto samāno abhisajjati kuppati byāpajjati patitthīyati, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti.
sac'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo pañhaṃ puṭṭho samāno aññen'aññaṃ paṭicarati, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmeti, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātukaroti, evaṃ sant'āyaṃ, bhikkhave, puggalo akaccho hoti.

45451.synonym: uppādayati, uppādeti, janeti, nipphādeti, pasavati, savati

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, aggivessana, allaṃ kaṭṭhaṃ sasnehaṃ udake nikkhittaṃ. atha puriso āgaccheyya uttar'āraṇiṃ ādāya, aggiṃ abhinibbattessāmi, tejo pātukarissāmī'ti.

yadā, bhante, brahmā sanaṅkumāro devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ pātubhavati, oḷārikaṃ attabhāvaṃ abhinimminitvā pātubhavati. yo kho pana, bhante, brahmuno pakativaṇṇo anabhisambhavanīyo so devānaṃ tāvatiṃsānaṃ cakkhupathasmiṃ.
yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, vidhūpayaṃ tiṭṭhati mārasenaṃ, sūriyo'va obhāsayam'antalikkhan'ti.
sahassakaṇḍaṃ satabheṇḍu, dhajālu haritāmayaṃ, satasahassaniyyūhā, byamhe pātubhaviṃsu me.
daḍḍhe ca kho pana bhagavato sarīre antalikkhā udakadhārā pātubhavitvā bhagavato citakaṃ nibbāpesi.
ajjhattikañc'eva, āvuso, cakkhuṃ aparibhinnaṃ hoti, bāhirā ca rūpā na āpāthaṃ āgacchanti, no ca tajjo samannāhāro hoti, n'eva tāva tajjassa viññāṇabhāgassa pātubhāvo hoti.
katamā ca, bhikkhave, jāti? yā tesaṃ tesaṃ sattānaṃ tamhi tamhi sattanikāye jāti sañjāti okkanti abhinibbatti khandhānaṃ pātubhāvo āyatanānaṃ paṭilābho, ayaṃ vuccati, bhikkhave, jāti.
yaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpaṃ jātaṃ pātubhūtaṃ, atthī'ti tassa saṅkhā, atthī'ti tassa samaññā, atthī'ti tassa paññatti, na tassa saṅkhā ahosī'ti, na tassa saṅkhā bhavissatī'ti.
ambho purisa na tvaṃ addasa manussesu tatiyaṃ devadūtaṃ pātubhūtan'ti? so evam'āha n'āddasaṃ bhante'ti

45460.grammar: aor of pātubhavati, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: tato me manasīkāro, yoniso udapajjatha, ādīnavo pāturahu, nibbidā samatiṭṭhatha.

45461.grammar: aor 3rd pl of pāturahosi, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: evam'eva, suddh'āvāsesu devesu antarahitā bhagavato purato pāturahesuṃ. atha kho tā devatā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

45462.grammar: aor of pātubhavati, comp vb, intrans

examples.text: bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye antarahito cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye āyasmato anuruddhassa sammukhe pāturahosi
evam'eva, suddh'āvāsesu devesu antarahitā bhagavato purato pāturahesuṃ. atha kho tā devatā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekam'antaṃ aṭṭhaṃsu.

bhuja ghasa hara su pā'icc'evam'ādīhi dhātūhi tum'icch'atthesu kha cha sa'icc'ete paccayā honti vā. bhottum'icchati, bubhukkhati, ghasitum'icchati, jighacchati, haritum'icchati, jigīsati, sotum'icchati, sussusati, pātum'icchati, pivāsati.
tena sammatena bhikkhunā animittaṃ katvā pātetabbaṃ. sace nimittaṃ katvā pāteti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
puriso ca te ukkhitt'āsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandhissati. yatth'eva naṃ thokam'pi chaḍḍessati tatth'eva te siro pātessatī'ti.
ayaṃ te, ambho purisa, chaṭṭho antaracaro vadhako ukkhitt'āsiko piṭṭhito piṭṭhito anubandho, yatth'eva naṃ passissāmi tatth'eva siro pātessāmī'ti.
tattha ca me, brāhmaṇa, viharato mago vā āgacchati, moro vā kaṭṭhaṃ pāteti, vāto vā paṇṇakasaṭaṃ ereti.
na sammā vattati, na lomaṃ pāteti, na netthāraṃ vattati, yena saṅgho attamano hoti taṃ karomī'ti n'āha.

45470.meaning2: having felled, having thrown off, having killed

examples.text: niṭṭhubhitvā'ti kheḷaṃ pātetvā.

so tasmiṃ ambavane rattiṭṭhāna-divāṭhāna-leṇakuṭi-maṇḍap'ādīni sampādetvā bhagavato anucchavikaṃ gandhakuṭiṃ kārāpetvā ambavanaṃ aṭṭhārasahatth'ubbedhena tambapaṭṭavaṇṇena pākārena parikkhipāpetvā buddhappamukhaṃ bhikkhusaṅghaṃ sacīvarabhattena santappetvā dakkhiṇ'odakaṃ pātetvā vihāraṃ niyyātesi.
gahapatiko pakkhanditvā asaniṃ pātento viya khandhe paharitvā rathaṃ ādāya agamāsi
ambho, rukkha, pubbe tvaṃ olambakaṃ otārento viya ujukam'eva phalāni pātesi
apehi dubbinīte, na tvaṃ amhākaṃ ayyāya pakkuthitaṃ sappiṃ āsiñcituṃ anucchavikā'ti, santajjentiyo ito c'ito ca uṭṭhāya hatthehi ca pādehi ca pothetvā bhūmiyaṃ pātesuṃ.
padumaṃ yathā kokanadaṃ sugandhaṃ, pāto siyā phullam'avītagandhaṃ, aṅgīrasaṃ passa virocamānaṃ, tapantam'ādiccam'iv'antalikkhe'ti.
atisītan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atiuṇhan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atisāyan'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atipāto'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atichāto'smī'ti kammaṃ na karoti, atidhāto'smī'ti kammaṃ na karoti.
sattame divase pāto'va uṭṭhāya gandh'odakena nhāyitvā cattāri satasahassāni vissajjetvā mahādānaṃ datvā sabb'ālaṅ'kāravibhūsitā varabhojanaṃ bhuñjitvā

45477.grammar: aor of pātukaroti, comp vb, trans (+acc)

examples.text: atha kho bhagavā sitaṃ pātv'ākāsi. atha kho tā devatāyo bhiyyosomattāya ujjhāyantiyo vehāsaṃ abbhuggañchuṃ.
abhijānām'ahaṃ, bho gotama, pūraṇaṃ kassapaṃ vādena vādaṃ samārabhitā. so'pi mayā vādena vādaṃ samāraddho aññen'aññaṃ paṭicari, bahiddhā kathaṃ apanāmesi, kopañ'ca dosañ'ca appaccayañ'ca pātv'ākāsi.

evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.

evam'eva kho tvaṃ, āvuso pāthikaputta, sugat'āpadānesu jīvamāno sugat'ātirittāni bhuñjamāno tathāgate arahante sammāsambuddhe āsādetabbaṃ maññasi. ke ca chave pāthikaputte, kā ca tathāgatānaṃ arahantānaṃ sammāsambuddhānaṃ āsādanā'ti.
evaṃ me sutaṃ… mallesu viharatī'ti pāthikasuttaṃ. tatr'āyaṃ apubbapadavaṇṇanā.
siṅgāl'āṭānāṭiyakaṃ, saṅgīti ca das'uttaraṃ, ekādasahi suttehi, pāthikavaggo'ti vuccati.

45482.meaningLit: canonical text of the section with Pāṭika

45483.commentary: (DHPa) pātheyyan'ti gamikassa taṇḍulādipātheyyaṃ viya paralokaṃ gacchantassa tava kusalapātheyyam'pi n'atthī'ti attho. (SNt) saddhā bandhati pātheyyan'ti saddhā nāma sattassa maraṇavasena mahāpathaṃ saṃvajato mahākantāraṃ paṭipajjato mahāviduggaṃ pakkhandato pātheyyapuṭaṃ bandhati sambalaṃ sajjeti.

examples.text: saddhā bandhati pātheyyaṃ, sirī bhogānam'āsayo, icchā naraṃ parikassati, icchā lokasmi dujjahā, icchābaddhā puthū sattā, pāsena sakuṇī yathā'ti.
paṇḍupalāso'va dāni'si, yamapurisā'pi ca te upaṭṭhitā, uyyogamukhe ca tiṭṭhasi, pātheyyam'pi ca te na vijjati.

45484.meaning1: sake of a provisions for a journey; purpose of provisions for the road
45484.commentary: (VINa) yaṃkiñci pātheyyatthāyā'ti maggaṃ gacchantānaṃ antarāmagg'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ yaṃkiñci baddhasattu-abaddhasattu-tila-taṇḍul'ādi sabbaṃ idha manthotv'eva saṅkhyaṃ gacchati.

examples.text: pūvaṃ nāma yaṃkiñci paheṇak'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ. manthaṃ nāma yaṃkiñci pātheyy'atthāya paṭiyattaṃ.

45485.meaningLit: discourse on provisions for a journey

examples.text: sā purimaṃ pādaṃ na suppatiṭṭhitaṃ patiṭṭhāpetvā pacchimaṃ pādaṃ uddhareyya.
puriso aṅkusam'ādāya, dehi pādan'ti yācati, nāgo pasārayī pādaṃ, puriso nāgam'āruhi.
seyyathā'pi, rāhula, rañño nāgo īsādanto urūḷhavā abhijāto saṅgām'āvacaro saṅgāmagato purimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti, pacchimehi'pi pādehi kammaṃ karoti
deva, idāni ṭhapetvā saccakiriyaṃ añño mama sakkhi n'atthi, sac'āyaṃ dārako tumhe paṭicca jāto, ākāse tiṭṭhatu, no ce, bhūmiyaṃ patitvā maratū'ti bodhisattassa pāde gahetvā ākāse khipi.

45488.commentary: (VINa) pādena kahāpaṇassa catutthabhāgaṃ akappiyabhaṇḍam'eva dasseti. (VINa) tadā rājagahe vīsatimāsako kahāpaṇo hoti, tasmā pañcamāsako pādo.

examples.text: yathārūpaṃ nāma pādaṃ vā pād'ārahaṃ vā atirekapādaṃ vā.

45489.commentary: (DNa) iddhipādā'ti ettha ijjhan'aṭṭhena iddhi, patiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena pādā'ti veditabbā.

examples.text: cittamhi vasībhūt'āhaṃ, iddhipādā subhāvitā, chaḷabhiññā sacchikatā, kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ.
seyyath'īdaṃ, cattāro satipaṭṭhānā cattāro sammappadhānā cattāro iddhipādā pañc'indriyāni pañca balāni satta bojjh'aṅgā ariyo aṭṭh'aṅgiko maggo.

45490.meaning2: one-fourth of any measure or of a stanza

examples.text: karotha buddhasāsanaṃ, yaṃ katvā n'ānutappati, khippaṃ pādāni dhovitvā, ekam'ante nisīdathā'ti.
s'āhaṃ disvāna sambuddhaṃ, lokajeṭṭhaṃ anuttaraṃ, tassa pādāni vanditvā, ekam'antaṃ upāvisiṃ.

45493.meaning1: having feet; with legs; about feet

examples.text: yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre uparivehāsakuṭiyā āhaccapādakaṃ mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā abhinisīdeyya vā abhinipajjeyya vā, pācittiyaṃ.
navaṃ pana bhikkhunā mañcaṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā kārayamānena aṭṭh'aṅgulapādakaṃ kāretabbaṃ sugat'aṅgulena aññatra heṭṭhimāya aṭaniyā. taṃ atikkāmayato chedanakaṃ pācittiyaṃ.

45494.meaning1: serving as a support; based on

examples.text: agāmake pana araññe sukaraṃ yog'āvacarena idaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ pariggahetvā ān'āpānacatutthajjhānaṃ nibbattetvā tadeva jhānaṃ pādakaṃ katvā saṅkhāre sammasitvā aggaphalaṃ arahattaṃ pāpuṇituṃ. tasm'āssa anurūpasen'āsanaṃ dassento bhagavā araññagato vā'ti-ādim'āha.
tañ'hi pādakajjhānassa paccayo hoti. passaddhī'ti darathapaṭippassaddhi. sā hi appanāpubbabhāgassa sukhassa paccayo hoti.

45497.meaning1: pebbles to wash the feet on; foot washing block
45497.meaning2: wooden block to wash feet on

examples.text: asaṇṭhahantā bhagavantaṃ paccuggantvā eko bhagavato pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahesi, eko āsanaṃ paññapesi, eko pād'odakaṃ, eko pādapīṭhaṃ, eko pādakaṭhalikaṃ upanikkhipi.

45498.meaning1: pebbles to wash the feet on; foot washing block
45498.meaning2: gravel to wash the feet on; foot washing block

examples.text: nivattantena paṭhamataraṃ āgantvā āsanaṃ paññapetabbaṃ, pād'odakaṃ pādapīṭhaṃ pādakathalikaṃ upanikkhipitabbaṃ, paccuggantvā pattacīvaraṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ, paṭinivāsanaṃ dātabbaṃ, nivāsanaṃ paṭiggahetabbaṃ.

45499.meaning1: having made a basis; having used as a supporting condition

examples.text: ān'āpānacatutthajjhānaṃ nibbattetvā, tadeva pādakaṃ katvā vipassanaṃ vaḍḍhetvā, maggapaṭipāṭiyā adhigatena catutthamaggena sabbakilese khepetvā sabbabuddhaguṇe paṭivijjhi, idam'assa paññākiccaṃ. evaṃ samādhi paññaṃ na pāpuṇāti.
